PinePollenMacro.exe
===================

Windows launcher for Bee Swarm Simulator (Roblox place 1537690962).

1. Double-click PinePollenMacro.exe
2. License key: admintest123
3. Bee Swarm Simulator opens through the official Roblox protocol:
   roblox://experiences/start?placeId=1537690962

Rebuild with: bash tools/build_windows_exe.sh
